testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reorder and remove staged commands ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog has staged "2D Sketches" followed by "3D Annotations" ✔ When the user selects "3D Annotations" and clicks the up arrow ✔ Then "3D Annotations" appears above "2D Sketches" ✔ When the user selects the "Large" checkbox for "3D Annotations" ✔ Then its "Large" checkbox is checked ✔ When the user removes "3D Annotations" with the left transfer button ✔ Then "3D Annotations" returns to the available commands list ✔ And "2D Sketches" remains in the custom panel list
